relations.text: 患者モニターにMasimoの技術を統合する協業を更新
relations.text_en: Renewed collaboration to integrate Masimo technologies into its patient monitors

source.label: Philips 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: A renewed collaboration with Masimo aims to integrate advanced technologies in Philips' multi-parameter patient monitoring platforms.

companies.name: エピック・システムズ

relations.text: 心電図モニタリングをEpicの電子カルテと統合する協業
relations.text_en: Collaboration to integrate cardiac monitoring services with Epic

source.label: Philips 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Philips announced a collaboration with Epic Systems, the leading electronic health record company, to integrate Philips' suite of cardiac ambulatory monitoring and diagnostics services with Epic Systems' specialty diagnostics suite.

relations.text: クラウド型AI読影ソリューションで提携

source.label: Philips 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: the Smart Reading cloud-based AI solutions, in partnership with Cortechs.ai, aim to enable zero-click workflows.

relations.text_en: Preferred in-network provider for Optum in the US (cardiac monitoring)

source.label: Philips 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: As part of a national agreement with Optum Healthcare in the US, Philips has become a preferred in-network provider for cardiac ambulatory monitoring services.
